Dear students

It has been observed that someone with a fake dp and saying he is an NIT student has been calling students to financially help him as he is in deep trouble, As such you are advised to ignore such calls and report the same to your warden , hall assistant for information and necessary action, please share with your friends and colleagues, 

Regards

Dr Shashikant ADSW
